namespace_reconciliation: Root actually provisioned io-lanes-v1 under original proposal7b49a431. Adopt this SOLE namespace; v2 physical-io-lanes-v1 path suggestion is historical/unprovisioned and will NOT be created. Root manifest is preserved unchanged.
trusted_authority: Manifest storageDomain is coordination nonce plus hostname observation, not physical topology/hardware attestation. Pin exact bytes and existing directory/barrier identities. Missing/replaced/aliased/nonprivate files refuse; consumers never create/repair.

api.read: GlobalPool.read(exactManifestPath, exactManifestSha): bounded owned regular nofollow stable metadata; refuse any lanes/qualified topology/other claim mode. Does not open IO namespace.
api.try_acquire: Fresh directory/barrier descriptions; held+visible checks, NB EX flock same barrier; revalidate; returns Lease or None. None means known partial descriptions closed, not permission to bypass.
api.bundle: try_io_cpu_bundle(ioPool,cpuPool,authorizedIndexes): IO first, CPU ascending whole exact set second. CPU contention rolls all CPU partials and IO back before return. Authority to CPU indexes must come separately from exact standing8/8 policy, not arbitrary caller indexes.
api.native_ui: Not implemented in backend. Native consumer must try existing native/UI lease nonblocking AFTER IO+CPU; rollback all earlier stages before waiting if busy. Existing Photo/UI or migration locks never repurposed.
api.close: Inherited FDs held until actual child/group/worker settlement. Lease.close_after_verified_settlement CONSUMES caller proof, does not establish closure. close_unstarted is only known no-child rollback. No LOCK_UN/destructor/unconditional finally unlock/numeric-FD retry.
api.unknown: UnresolvedOwnership carries retainedFDs+uncertainFD; owning wrapper retains live process/known FDs and records unknown; not a busy/retry signal.

consumer_requirements: Both source consumers adopt SAME exact manifest/backend contract or independently source-reviewed equivalent; no live bulk join from provisioning/test success alone.
Source/policy/manifest checks precede acquisition; revalidate manifest/current held inode bindings before dispatch. Manifest changes require refusal/review; no transparent new namespace or lane.
Unknown physical topology remains same exclusive global barrier. No shared-barrier or per-device lanes in this backend; future qualified topology/immutable successor required.
Complete local jobs/endpoint phases only. Never hold IO across peer-dependent RPC wait. Distributed/loopback multi-owner deadlock behavior requires separate integration qualification.
No current Unison production IoAdmission, PhotoV7 or newer production adapter uses this module merely from publication. Current kernel module is a local developer backend only.
